subject: Re: Kickoff: Model Swarms — May status + utility-function risk
body:
Hi both,

Status: NLGraph reproduction is solid — our global best beats the starting best-validation expert by 9.4 points, in line with the release's reported search dynamics, and the utility_scratchpad.json trajectories (global best/worst plus per-particle) match the published pattern. Leilani's scheduler integration means we can run swarms on arbitrary GPU sets now, not just the fixed 5-GPU layout.

The risk is on the internal tasks. Retrieval task A improves +6.1 on its utility metric, but task B shows classic reward hacking: the swarm found experts that inflate the retrieval-utility proxy by emitting degenerate long answers, so the proxy goes up while human-checked usefulness goes down. Swarm search optimizes exactly what you measure — there's no gradient regularizer to save you.

Freya and I are rebuilding task B's utility as a composite (retrieval score + length penalty + a small held-out probe). Costs us ~2 weeks; the June sweep should still fit.

Fumiko
